v49_frozen_retrieval_benchmark.purpose: FAST MVP lane directive: the smallest executable retrieval/counter-authority benchmark that can falsify the product. The frozen reality benchmark measures recorded ANSWER artifacts; this one measures whether the frozen controlling authorities are reachable at all in independent OpenCaseLaw retrieval, in which query language, at what rank, with what duplicates and at what latency. Baseline = one plain /decisions search per (question, language, channel) with no query-map/counter-authority machinery, per the lane directive.
v49_frozen_retrieval_benchmark.scope: 4 frozen questions x {fr,de,it} x {baseline question text, counter limiting-authority query} = 24 live searches against https://mcp.opencaselaw.ch/api/decisions, plus an offline cache replay pass. 36 frozen gates: authority recall (union + per-language, >=1-of-set), governing-norm retrievability, known-counter recall, independently verified limiting-marker evidence, source validity, duplicate structure, transport, per-search latency (30s), full-pass latency (240s), cached reproducibility. Authority sets re-owned from the frozen reality benchmark (sha ff57f556...); known-counter ids = union of counter-classified cited_decisions rows across accepted reality_check legs (label soundness NOT re-verified; stated in the spec).

falsifying_findings.F1_language_brittleness: For all three questions with a frozen authority set, the GERMAN plain-query baseline retrieves authorities inside top-50 (corporate 2/2 at ranks 18/23, BJR 2/5 at ranks 9/11, petty-theft 1/2 at rank 2) while the FRENCH and ITALIAN baselines retrieve ZERO of them (0/2, 0/5, 0/2). Union gates pass only via DE. The frozen questions' record language is French — the language the product ships.
falsifying_findings.F2_bjr_is_answer_side_not_reachability: Independent DE baseline retrieves bger_4A_219_2015 (rank 9) and bger_4A_603_2014 (rank 11); the fresh accepted BJR leg cites NONE of the five frozen BJR authorities. EXPLORATORY cross-check: all five frozen BJR authorities are present in the ACCEPTED product's own query_cache search envelopes (2-4 envelopes each, reached via expansion queries) and in ZERO of the 10 accepted envelopes whose query equals the frozen French question text; petty-theft bger_4A_228_2015 appears in exactly 1 accepted envelope vs 7 for bger_4A_177_2017. Discrimination: BJR 0/5 is a candidate-selection/answer-synthesis defect with French-path expansion reliance, not a corpus-reachability defect.
falsifying_findings.F3_duplicates_and_malformed_ids: 63 alias-duplicate cores across 7 of 24 queries; verified same-decision dual-docket pairs (ge_gerichte_C_6552_2022 + ge_gerichte_ACJC_1511_2022 same date; vd_findinfo_HC___2013___801 + vd_gerichte_JL13.022381 same date; ge_gerichte_P_17078_2019 + ge_gerichte_ACPR_74_2021 same date). 6 malformed upstream ids confirmed in raw sha-verified bodies (ch_vb__td_class__metadataCell__150000044__td_ whose docket_number is a live HTML fragment; four ge_gerichte_[pjdoc NNNNN]). Dedupe by canonical id + cross-docket alias detection + id sanitation are load-bearing product steps.
falsifying_findings.F4_corporate_marker_proxy_blind: No corporate counter-channel row carried both 'art. 102' and a frozen limitation token inside the frozen 600-char text head (90 rows); known-counter recall for the same question PASSES 4/6. Necessary-not-sufficient lexical proxy with frozen truncation; cause not separable from this record.
falsifying_findings.F5_retrieval_latency_eats_the_budget: 24-search live pass 256.827s >= frozen 240s budget, leaving <45s for rerank + answer + counter pass + map inside the product's hard <300s full-run budget; consistent with observed ~316-469s product latencies on free models.
